purpose: Local routing manifest for BETUFU agents. It selects focused guidance; it does not grant authorization or install skills.
selection: Choose the smallest bundle matching the active plan. Always include betufu-wave-guardrails.

planning.when: Exploring the codebase, preparing a plan, or assessing refactor impact.

backend-api.when: Changing Spring Boot, Java, persistence, authorization, migrations, or HTTP APIs.

frontend-angular.when: Changing Angular components, Signals, stores, adapters, routes, or templates.

ui-e2e.when: Changing visible behavior, responsive layout, accessibility, or browser flows.

security.when: Reviewing authentication, authorization, privacy, injection, XSS, SSRF, running Strix pentests, fixing findings, or gating CI.

verification-review.when: Verifying a completed plan, auditing tests, reviewing a snapshot, or checking phase integration.

repowise_policy.preferred_order: Use RepoWise MCP/LSP before native search whenever the tools are available.
repowise_policy.batching: Call independent structural lookups together; chain only when one result is the next query input.
repowise_policy.fallback: If RepoWise is unavailable, use read-only native inspection, record the limitation, and never claim a RepoWise lookup occurred.
